cards.name: Touch Calligraphic Brush
cards.summary: Calligraphic brush bundled in every one of the 25 brush library files (this entry is the copy in Arrows_Standard); it is not an arrow. On the S-curve it draws a heavy, even-width black stroke with rounded ends and no visible thick-thin modulation, far heavier than the 1 pt stroke it was applied to. (Thumbnail: the brush applied by script to a 300 pt S-curve with a 1 pt stroke.)
use_for: chunky single-weight doodles and hand-drawn icons drawn with the Paintbrush tool
avoid: arrows: it has no head; use an arrow brush from Pattern Arrows or Arrows_Standard
fine or delicate lines: it is very heavy even at 1 pt; a plain stroke with round caps gives the same look, editable in the Stroke panel
thick-thin calligraphy: the thumbnail shows an even width; use a calligraphic brush with a flat, angled nib
cards.applies_to: a stroked path item (open or closed); a Calligraphic brush (Adobe Calligraphic Brush Tool / Calligraphic Brush Plugin) that draws the path with an elliptical nib. The brush must exist in the target document; every brush library file holds a copy.
